checks.message: Verify the access point policy restricts access to specific VPCs or IAM principals
checks.context: S3 access points provide named network endpoints with their own access policies. A permissive access point policy can bypass the bucket policy and expose data to unintended consumers.

checks.message: Any application using this access point ARN will immediately lose access
checks.context: Applications referencing the access point ARN in their SDK configuration or IAM policies will fail. Verify all consumers have been migrated to a different access point or direct bucket access.

checks.message: BlockPublicAcls disabled in account-level public access block configuration
checks.context: Without BlockPublicAcls=true, public ACLs can still be applied to any bucket in the account.

checks.message: IgnorePublicAcls disabled in account-level public access block configuration
checks.context: Without IgnorePublicAcls=true, existing public ACLs on any bucket in the account still grant public access.

checks.message: BlockPublicPolicy disabled in account-level public access block configuration
checks.context: Without BlockPublicPolicy=true at the account level, individual bucket policies can still grant public access - and a bucket policy could even disable bucket-level block public access settings.

checks.message: RestrictPublicBuckets disabled in account-level public access block configuration
checks.context: Without RestrictPublicBuckets=true, public bucket policies still allow cross-account access to any bucket in the account.
